scope_note: Second-pass public-evidence audit for Apple's Washoe County data-center campus at 21505 Reno Technology Parkway West and its 2024 expansion application. GOED audit findings, application forecasts, county permit values, parcel assessments, a water-right allocation, operator-reported electricity use, and recipient-reported donation bands remain separate evidence states and scopes. Permit values are administrative amounts and are not summed because overlapping scopes cannot be ruled out. Assessment values are parcel stocks, not investment or tax receipts. The 125 acre-foot water right is regulatory capacity, not measured use. Food Bank gifts are company-region transfers, not campus-attributable annual spending. No campus total is allocated to the selected mapped building; the four-building campus, later buildout cases, downtown Reno warehouse, supporting renewable projects, fire-station parcel, and more-than-200-person support statement are not collapsed into one footprint. No Switch Citadel or Storey County amount enters this fragment. Vendor payments, worker residence, taxes received by jurisdiction, realized 2024 abatement, same-scope public-service cost, wastewater, and building-level electricity or water remain unobserved.

project_updates.title: Original incentive audit findings remain campus-level
project_updates.notes: GOED's fiscal-year 2012 audit table reports 83 jobs, a $38.42 average wage, and $689,829,656 of capital expenditure for Apple after compliant two- and five-year audits. The table does not allocate the findings among buildings, separate construction from equipment, or report realized tax receipts or public-service costs.
project_updates.project_description: Apple's Washoe County data-center campus is located at 21505 Reno Technology Parkway West near Reno, Nevada, and is operated by Apple. The project key represents one mapped building, while source records describe a four-building campus that began operating in 2012, later buildout permits, supporting renewable projects, and a distinct 2024 expansion application; those boundaries are kept separate from tenant equipment and other Apple properties. County and operator records document completed construction activity, parcel development, water-right capacity, and campus-level electricity use.

project_updates.title: Expansion packet preserves forecasts rather than realized effects
project_updates.notes: GOED packet query Apple Inc./21505 Reno Technology Parkway W reviewed all 16 pages. It separately schedules $163 million of construction, $742,071,428 of first-five-year equipment, ten additional FTE at $32.51, $200,909,110 of projected local taxes, and $62,153,275 of estimated abatement. No board-order, tax-return, invoice, payroll, or later audit in the packet converts those forecasts into actuals.

project_updates.title: Exact-address permit search adds direct construction observations without summing scopes
project_updates.notes: Searched Washoe County permit-report family for 2012-2026 using 21505 RENO TECHNOLOGY PKWY W, APPLE INC, PROJECT HUCKLEBERRY and PROJECT ISABEL. Main records located: 15-3589 ($37,913,134.77), 16-2026 ($9,140,880), and WBLD17-100303 ($50,720,905.86). Also located 15-3956, 16-1555, WBLD17-100612, WBLD17-102177 and WBLD17-103570 through -103582; those subordinate or zero-value permits are not added to the main permits because overlap cannot be excluded.

project_updates.title: Assessor, treasurer and recorder review yields parcel stocks but no receipt series
project_updates.notes: Searched Washoe Assessor secured rolls for Apple and APNs 084-110-20, 084-110-29, 084-110-30, 084-110-36, 084-110-37, 084-191-05 through -08 for tax years 2021/22 and 2024/25; normalized only main-campus APN 084-110-29. Queried the Treasurer parcel/owner portal and Recorder APN guidance. Public indexed results did not verify taxes paid, recipient-level receipts, delinquency/payment dates, or a complete deed consideration series; assessed values are therefore not converted to fiscal revenue.

project_updates.title: Planning cases separate campus buildout, substations and fire-station parcel
project_updates.notes: Reviewed Washoe planning families SW11-001/SW11-003, WSUP17-0008, WSUP18-0010, WAC23-0012, WSUP23-0031 and WTPM24-0007. Records map APNs and describe substation/building phases and a parcel for a fire station, but do not report realized Apple construction spend, facility load, fire-service operating cost, tax receipts, or building allocation. The fire-station parcel is not treated as a data-center building or quantified public cost.

project_updates.title: GOED amendment, compliance and audit follow-up finds no realized 2024 expansion amount
project_updates.notes: Searched GOED board packets, notices/minutes and NRS 231.0685 biennial reports through FY2024 for Apple, Washoe, data center, amendment, audit and compliance. The 2025 biennial report repeats the June 2012 account's 2017 audit findings. It does not show a completed audit, realized abatement, realized tax payment, or amended audited employment/capital result for the July 2024 expansion application.

project_updates.title: Nevada Tax Commission and Department of Taxation searches remain aggregate
project_updates.notes: Searched 2015-2026 Nevada Department of Taxation tax-expenditure reports, ad-valorem projections, Commission meeting archive and State Board of Equalization material for Apple, 084-110-29, Washoe, data center and abatement. Results were program- or jurisdiction-level; no Apple-specific realized sales/use abatement, property-tax payment, local receipt, appeal outcome, or 2024 expansion audit was verified.

project_updates.title: PUCN and NV Energy dockets triangulate renewable assets but not campus bills
project_updates.notes: Searched PUCN electric/renewable docket families and rate pages for Apple and dockets 12-11023, 13-07005, 15-11025, 17-02008 and 17-11002. Official filings confirm GreenEnergy Rider agreements, capacities, commissioning and 2022 project generation/REC transfers. They do not disclose Apple's campus kWh, demand, bill, tariff charge, avoided cost, or hourly resource matching; the independent campus-use observation comes from Apple instead.

project_updates.title: Water and sewer review finds a private system and capacity, not measured use
project_updates.notes: Searched TMWA board reports/current data-center guidance, Washoe water-right agenda items, Northern Nevada Public Health public-water-system references, and planning/permit text for Reno Technology Park, Apple, water, sewer, septic and wastewater from 2012-2026. County material identifies 125 acre-feet/year allocated to the data center; TMWA calls the system private. No meter, actual withdrawal/consumption, peak-day value, wastewater discharge, utility bill, or current same-scope sewer-cost series was found.

project_updates.title: Apple facilities archive supplies a 2025 campus electricity observation
project_updates.notes: Reviewed Apple Facilities Report 2013, Environmental Progress Reports 2023-2026, environment report archive, job-creation and newsroom pages for Reno/Nevada/data center. The 2026 report gives 422 million kWh in 2025 and cooling/renewable context. No Reno water volume, wastewater, power cost, building split, construction invoice, supplier payment, or public-service cost appears in the reviewed operator family.

project_updates.notes: Queried Apple Careers for Sparks/Reno/Nevada/data center and reviewed role IDs 200653833-6172, 200653810-6172, 200653832-6172, 200673896-6172 and 200674135-6172 plus data-center operations role 200665517-6172. These current postings document recruiting and occupation mix, but not filled positions, vacancies net of churn, worker residence, annual-average FTE, wages paid, benefits, payroll, or contractor headcount.

project_updates.title: Procurement and vendor search verifies roles but no payment amounts
project_updates.notes: Permit records name FCI Group, Simplex Grinnell, Desert Fire Protection, Stantec and project applicants on Apple-address work; Apple newsroom material separately describes K&N filter prototyping and a Nevada sheet-metal fabricator. Searches for Apple Reno vendor, contractor, procurement, purchase order and supplier payment found no contract value attributable to a named vendor, local-retained share, vendor payroll, or worker residence. Permit value remains construction evidence rather than supplier revenue.

project_updates.title: Named-recipient review verifies bounded gifts but not campus attribution
project_updates.notes: Searched official Envirolution, Children's Cabinet and Food Bank of Northern Nevada reports for Apple, grant, donation and Reno across 2020-2026. Food Bank recipient reports place Apple in the $10,000-$24,999 band in both 2021-2022 and 2022-2023; $10,000 lower bounds are recorded separately. Envirolution reports program activity near an Apple data center but not a clearly Apple-funded amount. No exact campus-designated annual community total was found.
